expectations.text: States the September 2026 ISM release (published September 3, 2026) added 44 new controls, ISM-2124 through ISM-2167
expectations.evidence: "44 new controls (ISM-2124 through ISM-2167)" and "published 3 September 2026"

expectations.text: Highlights the agentic AI controls (ISM-2156–2159): minimum tools/permissions, dual authorisation, untrusted external content handling, and central logging
expectations.evidence: "Agentic AI (ISM-2156–2159)... minimum tools, functions, and permissions... dual-authorisation model... External content... treated as untrusted... All tool invocations, external requests, and outputs must be centrally logged"

expectations.text: Mentions AI agent identity and register controls (ISM-2133–2135)
expectations.evidence: "AI agent identity (ISM-2133–2135)... unique identity... AI agent register"

expectations.text: Notes the single rescission: ISM-0521, the recommendation to disable IPv6 in dual-stack devices
expectations.evidence: "one rescission (ISM-0521, the recommendation to disable IPv6 in dual-stack devices)"

expectations.text: Mentions at least two other themes accurately: MACsec approval + MACsec controls, OAuth/third-party app consent controls, workload credential management, immutable backups, RMM allowlisting, synthetic impersonation verification, or the 6-monthly cadence tightening (KRBTGT/DCSync/pen tests)
expectations.evidence: "MACsec is now ASD-approved"; "Third-party OAuth (ISM-2137–2140)"; "DCSync... and KRBTGT... move from annual to 6-monthly"; immutable backups ISM-2151–2152; RMM allow-listing ISM-2149–2150
